blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Early identification of neurodegenerative disorders using structural T1-weighted MRI is essential for timely clinical intervention, yet supervised deep learning models often struggle to generalize due to limited annotations and scanner-induced distribution shift. Self-supervised learning offers a promising alternative; however, existing approaches are largely adapted from natural image paradigms, relying on contrastive objectives or generic masked reconstruction with voxel-wise losses, which may not fully capture the distributed morphometric patterns associated with neurodegeneration.
  We introduce SYMBA (SYstematic Morphometric Brain Autoencoding), a self-supervised pretraining framework specifically designed for structural brain MRI. SYMBA integrates anatomically constrained masking, a multi-scale structural similarity (MS-SSIM) reconstruction objective, and a progressive curriculum that transitions from local anatomical detail to global brain morphology. These components explicitly incorporate neuroanatomical structure into the self-supervised objective rather than relying on generic image priors.
  Pretrained on 6,953 T1-weighted MRI scans from nine heterogeneous cohorts, SYMBA is evaluated using frozen linear probing on two independent unseen datasets, enabling a strict assessment of out-of-distribution generalization. Across multiple clinical tasks, SYMBA consistently outperforms recent neuroimaging foundation models, achieving 0.930 AUROC for Alzheimer's disease classification, 0.772 for mild cognitive impairment conversion prediction, and strong performance in amyloid status prediction. In low-label regimes, SYMBA demonstrates high sample efficiency, reaching approximately 0.90 AUROC for AD/CN classification using only six labeled subjects.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Self-supervised learning (SSL) has emerged as a transformative paradigm in neuroimaging, enabling the extraction of robust, transferable anatomical representations directly from large collections of unlabeled brain scans Li et al. (2025) ; Chen et al. (2026) . A primary motivation for self-supervised representation learning in medical imaging is its ability to train effective downstream models and transfer them to very small patient populations, which is a critical bottleneck in clinical domains where expert annotations are labor-intensive, expensive, and scarce Moradi et al. (2014) .
blocks.zh: 自我监督的学习(SSL)已作为神经成像的变革范式出现,能够直接从大集合的无标签脑扫描Li等人(2025年);Chen等人(2026年)中提取强健,可转移的解剖表达. 在医疗成像中自我监督的表达学习的一个主要动机是能够培训有效的下游模型,并将模型转移给非常小的病人群体,这是临床领域的一个关键瓶颈,在临床领域,专家说明是劳动密集型的,昂贵的,以及稀缺的莫拉迪等人(2014年).

blocks.en: In this context, high-dimensional modalities like structural T1-weighted magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) provide rich volumetric depictions of brain anatomy, making them ideal for learning transferable 3D morphological representations. Neurodegeneration is an extensively studied application domain and an excellent testbed for evaluating these methodological advances. Because neurodegenerative conditions manifest as subtle, progressive structural changes distributed across interconnected brain networks Jack et al. (2010) , testing representation learning frameworks in this domain rigorously assesses their capacity to capture complex morphometric patterns under low-sample regimes and population heterogeneity.
blocks.zh: 在这方面,结构T1加权磁共振成像(MRI)等高维模式为大脑解剖学提供了丰富的体积描述,使它们成为学习可转移的3D形态表现的理想. 神经降解是一个广泛研究的应用领域,是评估这些方法进步的极佳试验床。 因为神经衰变状况 表现为微妙的,渐进的结构变化 分布在互相连接的大脑网络 Jack等人(2010年),测试这一领域的表现学习框架,严格评估其在低样本制度和人口异质性下捕捉复杂摩度测定模式的能力.

blocks.en: Despite their performance on curated research cohorts Wen et al. (2020) , supervised DL models for neuroimaging remain difficult to translate into routine clinical practice Teo et al. (2026) . Their reliance on large, expertly annotated datasets limits scalability, as obtaining reliable diagnostic labels is both labor-intensive and expensive. This challenge is particularly pronounced for rare or highly heterogeneous neurodegenerative disorders, where pathological variability further reduces the availability of representative training samples. In addition, supervised models are often sensitive to distribution shifts arising from differences in scanner manufacturers, acquisition protocols, and patient populations, limiting their ability to generalize across clinical sites Nooner et al. () ; Guo et al. (2026) .
blocks.zh: 尽管他们在研究组上的表现 Wen等人(2020年),受监督的神经成像DL模型仍然难以转化为常规临床实践Teo等人(2026年). 它们依赖大型的、有专家说明的数据集,限制了可扩展性,因为获得可靠的诊断标签既需要劳动力,又需要花费大量资金。 这一挑战在罕见或高度多样化的神经退化性疾病中尤为突出,在这些疾病中,病理变异性进一步减少了具有代表性的培训样本。 此外,受监督的模型往往对扫描仪制造商、采购协议和病人群体的差异引起的分配变化敏感,限制了它们将分布在诺纳等人的临床场所中的能力。 ();郭等 (2026).

blocks.en: Recent advances in SSL, by contrast, have shown remarkable success in downstream neuroimaging tasks Chen et al. (2026) such as brain segmentation, image registration, and anatomical correspondence, where learned representations can transfer across datasets and imaging protocols. Representative examples include BrainSegFounder Cox et al. (2024) and BrainMorph Wang et al. (2025) , which leverage large-scale pretraining to improve segmentation and registration performance. However, comparatively few self-supervised pretraining frameworks have been specifically designed for neurodegenerative disease analysis, where the learning objective fundamentally differs from these structural tasks and requires capturing subtle, distributed morphometric alterations associated with disease progression rather than precise anatomical localization.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,SSL最近的进步在下游神经成像任务中显示出显著的成功. 陈等. (2026)比如脑分裂,图像注册,以及解剖通信,在那里,学到的表达可以跨数据集和成像协议传输. 代表性的例子包括BrainSegFounder Cox等人(2024年)和BrainMorph Wang等人(2025年),他们利用大规模预训来提高分化和注册性能. 然而,相对较少的自我监督的预训框架被专门设计用于神经退化性疾病分析,其中学习目标与这些结构任务有着根本的区别,需要捕捉与疾病进展相关的微妙的,分布式的摩擦性改变,而不是精确的解剖局部化.

blocks.en:
Although structural image segmentation and registration rely primarily on the accurate localization of anatomical boundaries, representation learning for neurodegenerative disease analysis requires capturing subtle, spatially distributed morphometric alterations that progressively affect large-scale brain networks rather than isolated brain regions Akan et al. (2025) ; Huang and Zhang (2022) . Clinically relevant biomarkers in structural MRIs, such as cortical atrophy, ventricular enlargement, or hippocampal atrophy, manifest as gradual macroscopic changes that, while initially localized, progressively extend across multiple interconnected anatomical regions as the disease evolves Huang and Zhang (2022) .
Consequently, effective self-supervised pretraining for neurodegeneration should encourage representations that model global brain morphology and long-range anatomical relationships instead of focusing solely on local structural patterns.
blocks.zh:
虽然结构图像的分解和注册主要依赖于解剖边界的准确本地化,但神经变性疾病分析的表达学需要捕捉到微妙的,空间分布的摩度变化,这些变化逐渐影响大型脑网络,而不是孤立的脑区域Akan等人(2025年);黄和张(2022年). 结构MRI中临床相关的生物标记,如皮质萎缩,心胸扩张,或河马萎缩,表现为逐渐的宏观变化,虽然最初是局部化的,但随着疾病的演化,逐渐扩展到多个互联互通的解剖区(2022年).
因此,有效的自我监督的神经衰老前期训练应当鼓励表征模式化全球脑形态学和远程解剖关系,而不是只注重局部结构模式。

blocks.en: Recent studies have begun extending SSL to neurodegenerative disease analysis. For example, BrainIAC Tak et al. (2024) and AnatCL Barbano et al. (2026) demonstrate that contrastive pretraining can improve downstream diagnostic and prognostic classification tasks by learning transferable anatomical representations from large-scale MRI collections. These studies provide encouraging evidence that self-supervised representation learning is a promising direction for neurodegeneration. However, they also highlight that the design of effective pretraining objectives remains largely unexplored, with current approaches relying predominantly on contrastive learning paradigms whose relative advantages over generative objectives have yet to be systematically investigated.
blocks.zh: 最近的研究已经开始将SSL扩展到神经变性疾病分析. 举例来说,BrainIAC Tak等人(2024年)和AnatCL Barbano等人著. (2026)证明对比性预训可以通过学习大型核磁共振集合的可转移解剖表达,改进下游诊断和预知分类任务. 这些研究提供了令人鼓舞的证据,表明自我监督的表达学习是神经衰老的有希望的方向. 然而,他们还强调,有效的培训前目标的设计基本上仍未加以探讨,目前的做法主要依赖对比性学习模式,而这种模式相对于遗传性目标的相对优势尚待系统调查。

blocks.en:
Despite these encouraging results, several fundamental questions remain unanswered.
First, although contrastive learning has become the dominant paradigm in self-supervised neuroimaging, the relative advantages of contrastive and generative pretraining objectives remain largely unexplored for neurodegenerative disease representation learning Wu et al. (2025) . Second, little consensus exists regarding the most appropriate architectural choices, pretraining datasets, or evaluation protocols for assessing representation quality. Existing studies predominantly rely on end-to-end fine-tuning, making it difficult to disentangle the contribution of the learned representations from that of downstream optimization Munk et al. (2026) ; Moradi et al. (2015) . Finally, current generative approaches largely inherit masking strategies and reconstruction objectives originally developed for natural images. Regular cubic masking patterns and voxel-wise reconstruction losses such as Mean Squared Error (MSE) do not explicitly account for the hierarchical and spatially correlated organization of brain anatomy, potentially limiting their ability to learn morphometrically meaningful representations suitable for neurodegenerative disease analysis.
blocks.zh:
尽管取得了这些令人鼓舞的成果,但若干基本问题仍未得到解决。
首先,虽然对比性学习已经成为自我监督神经成像中的主要范例,但对比性和基因前训练目标的相对优势对于神经退化性疾病表现学习吴等人(2025年)仍然基本上没有被探索. 第二,在最适当的建筑选择、培训前数据集或评估代表质量的评价协议方面几乎没有共识。 现有研究主要依靠端到端的微调,难以将所学表现与下游优化Munk等人(2026年);Moradi等人(2015年)的贡献分开. 最后,目前的遗传方法在很大程度上继承了最初为自然图像制定的掩盖战略和重建目标。 正常的立方面遮盖模式以及Mean Squared Error(MSE)等voxel-with重建损失,并没有明确地说明大脑解剖学的层次和空间关联组织,可能限制他们学习适合神经变性疾病分析的具有病理意义表述的能力.

blocks.en: We introduce SYMBA ( SY stematic M orphometric B rain A utoencoding), a self-supervised pretraining framework for learning morphometric brain representations tailored to neurodegenerative disease analysis. Rather than directly adopting masked autoencoding strategies developed for natural images, SYMBA introduces an anatomically constrained masking operator that generates geometrically diverse, anatomically coherent occlusions over 3D brain volumes. The proposed masking strategy is coupled with a structural reconstruction objective based on the Multi-Scale Structural Similarity (MS-SSIM) loss Wang et al. (2003) and a progressive masking curriculum that gradually shifts the learning task from recovering local anatomical details to modeling large-scale brain morphology. Together, these components encourage the encoder to learn biologically meaningful latent representations of brain morphology that are transferable to downstream neurodegenerative disease analysis.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了SYMBA(SY stemmatic M orphometric B rain A utoencoding),这是一个自行监督的预训框架,用于学习适合神经变性疾病分析的morphometric脑表现. SYMBA不是直接采用为自然图像制定的蒙面自动编码策略,而是引入了解剖约束的蒙面操作器,在3D脑体积上产生几何多样化,解剖一致的隔离. 拟议的遮掩战略与基于多尺度结构相似性(MS-SSIM)损失的Wang等人(2003年)的结构重建目标以及逐步的遮掩课程相配合,这些课程逐渐将学习任务从恢复局部解剖细节转向大规模脑形态模型化. 这些成分共同鼓励编码器学习生物上有意义的脑形态潜在表现,这些表现可转移到下游神经退化性疾病分析.

blocks.en: The resulting model is pretrained predominantly on cognitively healthy subjects from multiple large-scale cohorts, enabling learning transferable morphometric representations without relying on disease-specific supervision.
blocks.zh: 由此产生的模型主要是针对来自多个大群群的认知健康学科进行预先培训,从而能够学习可转移的摩度测定表现,而无需依赖针对疾病的监督。

blocks.en: We evaluate SYMBA under a challenging transfer learning setting, where representations pretrained on healthy control populations are transferred to two independent, previously unseen neurodegenerative cohorts, including Alzheimer’s disease. Performance is compared against recent self-supervised neuroimaging pretraining methods using strict frozen-representation protocols and low-label regimes, providing a controlled assessment of representation quality, transferability, and robustness under distribution shift.
blocks.zh: 我们以挑战性的转移学习环境来评价SYMBA, 将健康控制人群的预预科表现转移到两个独立且以前不为人知的神经退化人群, 包括老年痴呆症。 将性能与最近自我监督的神经成像预训方法进行比较,这些方法使用严格的冷冻代表协议和低标签制度,在分配转变时对表现质量、可转移性和稳健性进行有控制的评估。

blocks.en: SYMBA is a self-supervised masked representation learning framework designed to learn anatomically meaningful latent representations from structural brain MRI without requiring diagnostic labels. Unlike conventional masked autoencoders, SYMBA adapts the masking strategy and reconstruction objective to exploit the structural properties of brain anatomy.
blocks.zh: SYMBA是一个自我监督的蒙面表达学习框架,旨在从结构脑核磁共振中学习解剖上有意义的潜在表达,而不需要诊断标签. 与传统的蒙面自动编码器不同,SYMBA适应蒙面策略和重建目标,以利用大脑解剖学的结构属性.

blocks.en: 2.3 Reconstruction Objective
blocks.zh: 2.3 重建目标

blocks.en: Unlike conventional reconstruction objectives, which evaluate similarity over the entire image, SYMBA computes the reconstruction loss exclusively over the voxels removed by the masking operator. This prevents the model from receiving trivial supervision from already visible voxels and large homogeneous background regions, forcing it instead to recover the missing anatomical structures.
blocks.zh: 与评价整个图像的相似性的传统重建目标不同,SYMBA计算重建损失的完全是遮掩操作员清除的阴道. 这使得模型无法从已经可见的阴道和大同质背景区域得到微小的监管,迫使它恢复缺失的解剖结构.

blocks.en: We employ the Multi-Scale Structural Similarity (MS-SSIM) index Mallick et al. (2024) to compare the reconstructed and reference masked regions. Unlike voxel-wise losses such as Mean Squared Error, MS-SSIM jointly evaluates luminance, contrast, and structural similarity across multiple spatial resolutions, making it particularly suitable for preserving anatomical morphology in structural MRI.
blocks.zh: 我们使用多层次结构相似性指数Mallick等人(2024年)来比较被重建的和被掩盖的参照区域。 与Mean Squared Error等 voxel-wiseum不同,MS-SSIM联合评价了多个空间分辨率之间的亮度,对比度和结构相似性,使其特别适合在结构核磁共振中保留解剖形态.

blocks.en: 2.4 Downstream Tasks
blocks.zh: 2.4 下游任务

blocks.en: After self-supervised pretraining, the decoder is discarded and only the pretrained encoder f θ f_{\theta} is retained as a generic feature extractor. Given an input sMRI volume, the encoder produces a fixed-dimensional latent representation that serves as a compact description of the underlying brain morphology. These embeddings can subsequently be transferred to a variety of downstream tasks without requiring further representation learning.
blocks.zh: 经过自我监督的预训,解码器被丢弃,只有预训的解码器f QQQTHETA}被保留为通用特性提取器. 鉴于输入SMRI的体积,编码器产生一个固定维度的潜在代表,作为基本脑形态的紧凑描述. 这些嵌入物随后可以转移到各种下游任务,而不需要进一步的代表学习.

blocks.en: To evaluate the quality of the learned representations, we adopt a frozen linear probing protocol. Specifically, the encoder parameters remain fixed, and a linear logistic regression classifier is trained on the extracted embeddings for each downstream task. Compared with end-to-end fine-tuning, linear probing isolates the discriminative power of the latent representation from the capacity of the downstream model, providing a more direct assessment of the information captured during self-supervised pretraining. Moreover, its simplicity reduces the influence of optimization strategies and hyperparameter choices, allowing differences in downstream performance to be more confidently attributed to the quality of the learned representation.
blocks.zh: 为了评价学到的表述的质量,我们采用了一种冻结的线性探测程序。 具体地说,编码器参数仍然是固定的,而且对每个下游任务的提取嵌入物进行了线性物流回归分类器的培训。 与端对端的微调相比,线性测试将潜在代表的歧视性力量与下游模型的能力隔离开来,为在自我监督的预训中获取的信息提供了更直接的评估. 此外,其简单化降低了优化策略和超参数选择的影响,使得下游业绩的差异更有信心地归因于所学表现的质量.

blocks.en: To pretrain SYMBA, we assembled a heterogeneous structural brain MRI dataset comprising 6,953 T1-weighted scans collected from seven independent cohorts: Open Access Series of Imaging Studies (OASIS) LaMontagne et al. (2019) , Dallas Lifespan Brain Study (DLBS) Park et al. (2025) , IXI, SALD Wei et al. (2018) , Wayne Kennedy and Raz (2009) , NKI MacKay-Brandt et al. (2026) ; Nooner et al. () , and CamCAN Shafto et al. (2014) . While these cohorts each implemented highly standardized acquisition and quality-control protocols within their respective frameworks, they spanned a wide range of acquisition protocols (with varying magnetic field strengths of 1.5T and 3T), pulse sequence designs and spatial/temporal resolutions) , scanners(with manufacturers such as Siemens, GE or Philips), and subject populations. This heteroneity provided a rich source of anatomical variability for self-supervised representation learning. A summary of the pretraining dataset is provided in Table 1 . With the exception of OASIS, the pretraining corpus was composed predominantly of cognitively healthy individuals.
blocks.zh: 为了预先训练SYMBA,我们组装了一个由7个独立组群收集的6 953个T1加权扫描组成的结构脑磁共振数据集: LaMontagne等人(2019年),Dallas Livespan脑研究(DLBS) Park等人(2025年)、IX、SALD Wei等人(2018年)、Wayne Kennedy和Raz(2009年)、NKI MacKay-Brandt等人(2026年)、Nooner等人()和CamCAN Shafto等人(2014年)。 虽然这些组别在各自框架内执行了高度标准化的购置和质量控制协议,但它们涉及广泛的购置协议(磁场强度各不相同,分别为1.5T和3T)、脉冲序列设计和空间/时空分辨率),扫描仪(与西门子、GE或飞利浦等制造商一起)和主题人群。 这种异质性为自我监督的代表性学习提供了丰富的解剖变量来源. 培训前数据集摘要见表1。 除OASIS外,预训书主要由认知健康的个人组成.

blocks.en:

(2010) and the Australian Imaging, Biomarkers and Lifestyle (AIBL) study (AIBL study methodology has been reported previously Ellis et al. (2009) ). These datasets were obtained from the ADNI (http://adni.loni.usc.edu) and the AIBL study group (https://aibl.org.au). For up-to-date information, see (www.adni-info.org). The primary goal of ADNI has been to test whether serial magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), positron emission tomography (PET), other biological markers, and clinical and neuropsychological assessment can be combined to measure the progression of mild cognitive impairment (MCI) and early Alzheimer’s disease (AD).

blocks.en: To benchmark the utility of our proposed SSL approach against established SOTA SSL methods, we proposed the following tasks over the validation datasets: 1. Alzheimer’s Disease vs Cognitively Normal (AD vs CN) : Binary classification between participants diagnosed with Alzheimer’s Disease (AD) and cognitively normal controls (CN), including participants with subjective memory complaints (SMC). 2. MCI Progressive vs Stable (pMCI/sMCI) : Binary classification distinguishing participants with mild cognitive impairment who subsequently progressed to Alzheimer’s disease (pMCI) from those who remained clinically stable (sMCI). Stable MCI required at least five years of follow-up without progression, whereas pMCI participants were required to receive a dementia diagnosis during their final two consecutive clinical evaluations. Participants with insufficient follow-up or fluctuation in clinical assessment were excluded from the analysis. 3. 3-Class Categorization (3-class) : Three-class classification (CN, MCI, and AD) evaluating the ability of the learned representations to capture the continuum of Alzheimer’s disease progression. 4. Amyloid Status Classification (Amyloid) : Binary prediction of amyloid positivity ( A β + / − A\beta+/- )from structural MRI, assessing whether the learned anatomical representations encode information associated with molecular pathology. Amyloid labels were obtained using the UC Berkeley PET processing pipeline. ADNI PET acquisition and processing protocols are described in previously published methods Jagust et al. (2009) ; Joshi et al. (2012) ( https://adni.loni.usc.edu/methods/pet-acquisition/ , https://adni.loni.usc.edu/methods/pet-analysis-method/pet-analysis/ ). We obtained global and regional 18 F-florbetapir SUVR (standardized uptake value ratios) values from the UCBERKELEYAV45_04_26_22.csv table downloaded from the ADNI website ( https://adni.loni.usc.edu/ ). To determine AB-positivity, we used a cutoff value of 1.11 to the global SUVR, i.e., summary florbetapir cortical SUV normalized by whole cerebellum SUV Landau et al. (2014) . 5. Sex Classification (Sex) : Binary baseline mapping structural sexual dimorphism.

blocks.en: Image preprocessing was performed using the Computational Anatomy Toolbox (CAT12, version 9.0) with default parameters ( Gaser et al., 2024 ) https://neuro-jena.github.io/cat/ . (2015) ).

blocks.en: 3.3 Performance evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.3 考绩

blocks.en: To evaluate the transferability of the learnt representations, we compared SYMBA against representative state-of-the-art large-scale, self-supervised, pre-trained models for sMRI, spanning the main SSL paradigms currently adopted in neuroimaging. Specifically, we evaluated (1) BrainMorph Wang et al. (2025) , a geometric representation learning approach based on anatomical keypoint prediction for image registration, (2) BrainSegFounder Cox et al. (2024) , which performed two-stage pretraining using healthy and tumor MRIs for downstream segmentation, (3) AnatCL Barbano et al. (2026) , a contrastive framework exploiting region-of-interest information and (4) BrainIAC Tak et al. (2024) , which explored a SimCLR objective. To ensure a fair comparison, all external models were treated as frozen feature extractors and evaluated using the same linear probing protocol. Note that BrainMorph, AnatCL, and BrainIAC were originally pre-trained using ADNI as part of their pretraining datasets, whereas BrainSegFounder and SYMBA were pre-trained without any ADNI images. Consequently, while the ADNI evaluation provided a direct comparison with prior work under a common protocol, the AIBL cohort offered the strictest assessment of out-of-distribution generalisation, as none of the evaluated models were pre-trained on this dataset.
blocks.zh: 为了评价所学到的表述的可转移性,我们比较了SYMBA与具有代表性的大规模、自我监督、预先培训的SMRI模型,这些模型跨越了目前在神经成像中采用的主要SSL范式。 具体来说,我们评价了(1)BrainMorph Wang等人. (2025),基于解剖学关键点预测图像注册的几何表达式学习方法,(2)BrainSegFounder Cox等人(2024年),利用健康和肿瘤的MRI进行两阶段的预训,用于下游分化,(3)AnatCL Barbano等人(2026年),利用利益区域信息的对比性框架,(4)BrainIAC Tak et al. (2024),其中探讨了SimCLR的目标. 为了确保公平比较,所有外部模型都被当作冷冻特征提取器,并使用同样的线性检测协议进行评估. 注意BrainMorph,AnatCL,和BrainIAC最初是作为预训数据集的一部分使用ADNI进行预训的,而BrainSegFounder和SYMBA则在没有任何ADNI图像的情况下进行预训. 因此,虽然ADNI评价直接比较了以往在共同协议下开展的工作,但AIBL小组对分配外一般化进行了最严格的评估,因为所有被评价的模型都没有在这个数据集上经过预先培训。

Most of these improvements were statistically significant, although the margin over the strongest baselines narrowed and lost significance on the more challenging sMCI vs pMCI prediction task.

blocks.en: The performance gains were maintained in the AIBL cohort, where SYMBA again achieved the highest BACC and AUROC across all tasks, with significant differences over most baselines.
blocks.zh: 业绩收益维持在亚投行组内,SYMBA再次在所有任务中达到最高的BACC和AUROC,与大多数基线存在重大差异。

blocks.en: 3.4 Low-data regime evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.4 低数据制度评价

blocks.en: To evaluate the sample efficiency of the learned representations, we progressively reduced the amount of labelled training data available for downstream learning. For each task, the training set was randomly subsampled to 1 % \% , 2 % \% , 8 % \% , 25 % \% , 50 % \% , 75 % \% , and 100 % \% of the available participants, while the test partition remained fixed. Each subsampling was repeated 10 times per fold to account for both data subsampling and optimization variability.
blocks.zh: 为了评估所学到的表述的抽样效率,我们逐步减少了可供下游学习使用的贴有标签的培训数据的数量。 对于每项任务,培训集被随机抽查到1%的QQ,2%的QQ,8%的QQ,25%的QX,50%的QQ,75%的QQ,100%的可用参与者,而测试分区仍然固定. 每个子采样每折叠重复10次,以说明数据子采样和优化的可变性。

blocks.en: We compared SYMBA against two categories of baselines. The first was the same backbone trained end-to-end under full supervision from random initialization (no pretraining), following Tak et al. (2026) . The second was the set of four publicly available pre-trained neuroimaging models (AnatCL, BrainIAC, BrainMorph, and BrainSegFounder) evaluated under the same frozen-encoder, linear-probe protocol as SYMBA. This second comparison isolated whether SYMBA’s advantage came from pretraining in general or from the specific self-supervised objective proposed here.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了SYMBA和两类基线。 首先是在随机初始化(没有预训)的全面监督下,继Tak等人(2026年)之后,同一骨干培训的端对端。 第二套是四种公开使用的预先训练的神经成像模型(AnatCL,BrainIAC,BrainMorph,和BrainSegFounder),根据与SYMBA相同的冷冻编码器,线性检测协议来评价. 第二次比较将SYMBA的优势分别来自一般的预训还是此处提出的具体自我监督目标.

blocks.en: Figure 3 (a) shows that on AD vs CN, Sex, and Amyloid classification, SYMBA consistently outperformed both the supervised baseline and all four alternative large pre-trained models on the ADNI dataset, with the advantage being most notable when only a handful of labelled participants were available. Strikingly, with only five to six labelled samples, SYMBA already outperformed all four large pre-trained models on AD vs CN classification, despite three of them having encountered ADNI itself during their own pretraining. As more labels were added, the supervised baseline catched up, and the two methods converged by the time the full training set was used, whereas the alternative pre-trained models plateaued at a lower level throughout, never closing the gap to either SYMBA or the fully trained supervised model.
blocks.zh: 图3(a)显示,在AD vs CN、Sex和Amyloid分类中,SYMBA的业绩始终高于监督基线和ADNI数据集上所有四个经过预先培训的替代大型模型,在只有少数有标签的参与者的情况下,其优点最为显著。 尽管SYMBA在自己的预训期间遇到了ADNI本身,但SYMBA在AD vs CN分类上已经超过了全部四个经过预训的大型模型。 由于增加了更多的标签,监督基线赶上,两种方法在使用全套培训时趋于一致,而其他预先培训的模型则在整个阶段处于较低水平,从未将差距与SYMBA或经过充分培训的监管模型相连接。

blocks.en: The sMCI vs pMCI task departed from this pattern. SYMBA still provided the clearest advantage in the extreme low-data regime and remained ahead of all four alternative foundation models throughout. The supervised baseline, however, did not merely close the gap with increasing data: it overtook SYMBA once a moderate amount of labelled data became available and stayed ahead through the full training set.
blocks.zh: SMCI vs pMCI的任务偏离了这种模式. SYMBA仍然在极低数据制度中提供了最明显的优势,并始终领先于所有四种备选基础模型。 然而,所监督的基线并不仅仅通过不断增长的数据弥补差距:一旦获得适量的标注数据,就超过了SYMBA,并通过全套培训保持领先。

blocks.en: To assess whether these findings generalised beyond the pretraining cohort, we repeated the evaluation on the independent AIBL dataset for the three tasks available in it, AD vs CN, 3-Class, and sex classification (Figure 3 (b)). SYMBA remained the top-performing method across the full range of labelled data, and, unlike on ADNI, the fully supervised baseline did not fully catch up even at 100% of the data. The four alternative large pre-trained models again underperformed both SYMBA and the supervised baseline at essentially every data fraction. This was particularly notable for BrainMorph, which had already seen AIBL during its own pretraining and yet still trailed SYMBA on this cohort. The cross-cohort replication indicated that SYMBA’s representations transferred to genuinely unseen data rather than relying on prior exposure to the evaluation cohort.
blocks.zh: 为了评估这些结论是否超出预训组别的范围,我们重复了对独立AIBL数据集的评估,该数据集涉及AD vs CN、3-Class和性别分类(图3(b))。 SYMBA仍然是所有标注数据中表现最好的方法,与ADNI不同,完全监督的基准即使100%的数据也没有完全赶上。 四个备选的大型预训模型在基本每个数据分数上再次低于SYMBA和监督基准。 这一点对BrainMorph来说特别显著,BrainMorph在自己的前期训练中已经看到过ABIL,但在这批人上仍然跟随SYMBA. 交叉重复表明,SYMBA的表述转移到了真正看不见的数据上,而不是依赖先前与评价组的接触。

blocks.en: 3.5 Ablation study
blocks.zh: 3.5 阅读研究

blocks.en: To quantify the contribution of each design choice in SYMBA, we performed a controlled ablation study along three key axes of the proposed framework: (i) the autoencoder architecture, (ii) the pre-training paradigm, and (iii) the reconstruction objective. In each experiment, we isolated one design axis while keeping the remaining training configuration fixed, enabling us to assess its individual impact on downstream performance. This setup provided a systematic evaluation of how architectural and training choices affect the quality and transferability of the learned representations.
blocks.zh: 为了量化SYMBA中每个设计选择的贡献,我们按照拟议框架的三个关键轴线进行了有控制的减缩研究:(一) 自动编码器架构;(二) 培训前模式;(三) 重建目标。 在每次试验中,我们隔离一个设计轴,同时固定剩余的训练配置,使我们能够评估它对下游业绩的个别影响。 这一安排系统地评估了建筑和培训选择如何影响所学到的表述的质量和可转让性。

blocks.en: 3.5.1 Autoencoder architecture
blocks.zh: 3.5.1 自动编码器结构

blocks.en: We first analyzed the impact of the autoencoder architecture on representation quality by comparing three 3D architectures that differed in both model capacity and connectivity patterns: a large 3D U-Net with encoder-decoder skip connections (UNet L,  142.1M parameters), a medium-sized residual autoencoder (ResNet M,  63.4M parameters), and a larger residual autoencoder with increased representational capacity (ResNet L,  116.8M parameters). While ResNet M used a 3D-ResNet34 architecture with BasicBlock3D layers, ResNet L scaled up to a RD-ResNet50 backbone featuring Bottleneck3D layers. This comparison allowed us to disentangle the effect of network size from that of skip connections, which may facilitate low-level information transfer between encoder and decoder but can also reduce the pressure on the latent representation to capture semantically meaningful features.
blocks.zh: 我们首先分析了自动编码器架构对代表质量的影响,比较了三个在模型容量和连接模式上都不同的3D架构:一个具有编码器-解码器跳过连接的大型3D U-Net(UNet L,142.1M参数),一个中型剩余自动编码器(ResNet M,63.4M参数)和一个具有更高代表容量的较大剩余自动编码器(ResNet L,116.8M参数)。 虽然ResNet M使用了带有BasicBlock3D层的3D-ResNet34架构,但ResNet L则缩放为以Bottleneck3D层为主干线的RD-ResNet50. 这种比较使我们能够将网络大小的影响与跳过连接的效应分开,这可能有助于编码器和解码器之间的低级信息传输,但也能够减少潜在表示的压力,以捕捉到有目的的特性.

blocks.zh: 在AIBL组中,这种模式发生了转变: UNet L是AD vs CN (BACC)最强的架构,它与ResNet L在3-Class上具有竞争力,在BACC上略微落后,但在AUROC上领先.

blocks.en: 3.5.2 Masking strategy and SSL paradigm
blocks.zh: 3.5.2 化妆战略和SSL范式

blocks.en: We decoupled the analysis of SYMBA into two: (i) the choice of self-supervised pre-training paradigm, and (ii) the effect of the proposed anatomically constrained masking design. This separation allowed us to isolate whether performance gains arise from the general learning objective or from the masking strategy.
blocks.zh: 我们把SYMBA的分析解为两个: (一)自行监督的训练前范式的选择; (二)拟议的解剖限制的面具设计的效果. 这种分离使我们得以区分业绩收益是来自一般学习目标还是来自掩盖战略。

blocks.en: We first compared contrastive learning (SimCLR, using either a standard ResNet3D backbone or a BrainIAC-style encoder) against reconstruction-based pretraining under the proposed curriculum schedule, evaluated both with (SYMBA) and without (MAE) the anatomical shape-prior term. The latter served as the reconstruction-only counterpart to the full SYMBA objective, isolating the specific contribution of the shape prior within an otherwise identical curriculum-based training scheme.
blocks.zh: 我们首先将对比性学习(SimCLR,使用标准的ResNet3D主干线或BrainIAC式编码器)与拟议课程表下的基于重建的预培训进行比较,评估内容包括(SYMBA)和(MAE)解剖形状前术语。 后者只是与SYMBA目标完全相对应的重建项目,将形状之前的具体贡献隔离在一个原本相同的课程培训计划中。

blocks.en: To ensure a strictly controlled comparison across self-supervised paradigms, all objectives in Table 5 used a smaller backbone architecture (ResNet-Small). This modification was required by GPU VRAM limitations when managing contrastive methods like SimCLR that required large batch sizes. While SYMBA employed a larger backbone (ResNet-Large) in primary experiments throughout this paper, this uniform ResNet-Small setup ensured that observed performance differenced stem entirely from the pretraining objectives rather than architectural capacity.
blocks.zh: 为确保在自我监督的范式中进行严格控制下的比较,表5中的所有目标都采用了较小的骨干架构(ResNet-Small). 这种修改是GPU VRAM限制在管理SimCLR等需要大批量尺寸的对比方法时需要的. 虽然SYMBA在整个文件中在初级实验中采用了更大的主干线(ResNet-Large),但这种统一的ResNet-Small设置确保了观察到的性能差异完全来自培训前的目标,而不是建筑能力。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 5 , the full objective with the anatomical shape prior achieved the best or joint-best performance across most tasks and both cohorts, with its advantage over the contrastive baselines most pronounced on sex classification. Reconstruction-based pretraining without the shape prior (MAE) improved modestly over the contrastive baselines but fell consistently short of the full SYMBA objective.
blocks.zh: 如表5所示,以前具有解剖形状的全部目标在大多数任务和两个组别中都取得了最佳或最佳联合业绩,其优势在于性别分类上最突出的对比基线。 与对比性基线相比,没有形状(MAE)的基于重建的预训略有改进,但始终没有达到SYMBA的全部目标。

blocks.en: The exception to this pattern was amyloid status and 3-class discrimination on the external AIBL cohort, where plain SimCLR remained competitive with, or marginally ahead of, the shape-prior objective.
blocks.zh: 这种模式的例外是类固醇地位和对外部AIBL组群的3级歧视,在这些组群中,普通的SimCLR仍然与形状优先目标有竞争力,或略高于该目标。

blocks.en: Table 5 : Performance comparison of self-supervised representations across downstream tasks on ADNI and AIBL cohorts. Results were evaluated via linear probing and reported as mean ± \pm standard deviation across 10-fold cross-validation. For each model configuration, the top row (white background) reports Balanced Accuracy (BACC), while the bottom row (shaded gray) reports Area Under the ROC Curve (AUC). The best performance for each task and metric is in bold . Asterisks ( ∗ * ) denote statistically significant differences ( p < 0.05 p<0.05 , paired t t -test) compared to the baseline (SYMBA).
blocks.zh: 表5:ADNI和AIBL组别下游任务自我监督表述的绩效比较。 通过线性测试评估了结果,并报告为10倍交叉验证的平均值±\pm标准差。 对于每个模型配置,上行(白色背景)报告平衡精确度(BACC),而下行(阴影灰色)报告ROC曲线下的区域(AUC). 每个任务和衡量标准的最佳业绩用黑体表示。 与基线(SYMBA)相比,Asterisks(**)表示统计上的重大差异(p < 0.05 p < 0.05,配对 t-测试)。

blocks.en: We next analyzed the contribution of the individual components of the proposed SYMBA masking strategy through a leave-one-out ablation design, in which each variant removed a single constraint from the final SYMBA masking pipeline while keeping every other component fixed. This isolated the marginal contribution of each constraint independently, rather than assuming a fixed order in which they had to be introduced.
blocks.zh: 随后,我们通过一个 " 留一出 " 设计,分析了拟议SYMBA掩码战略各个组成部分的贡献,其中每个变体在最后SYMBA掩码管道中消除了单一的制约,同时保留了所有其他组成部分。 这孤立了每个制约的边缘作用,而不是假定必须引入这些制约的固定顺序。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 6 , removing the anatomical shape-prior term ( no shapes ) produced the broadest and most consistent degradation across tasks, and was the only change that reached statistical significance in most cases. The effect was largest on ADNI Sex classification (AUROC dropped from 0.94 to 0.89*, BACC from 0.86 to 0.81*) and ADNI 3-Class classification (AUROC 0.74 to 0.70*), with a smaller but still significant drop on ADNI AD vs CN AUROC (0.94 to 0.90*) and on AIBL Sex AUROC (0.92 to 0.88*).
blocks.zh: 如表6所示,去除解剖学的形状学前术语(无形状)在各种任务中产生最广泛和最一致的退化,并且是在大多数情况下具有统计意义的唯一变化。 对ADNI性别分类的影响最大(AUROC从0.94降至0.89*,BACC从0.86降至0.81*)和ADNI 3级分类(AUROC 0.74至0.70*),对ADNI AD对CN AUROC(0.94至0.90*)和AIBL性别AUROC(0.92至0.88*)的影响较小,但仍然显著下降。

blocks.en: Removing the background removal, hemispheric-symmetry, and minimum-tissue-fraction constraints together (anatomical validity constraints off) had a smaller and more selective effect. On ADNI AD vs CN and sMCI vs pMCI, performance was statistically indistinguishable from the full model on both metrics, and on several AIBL tasks (Sex BACC, AD vs CN AUROC, and 3-Class AUROC) the ablated variant performs on par with, or nominally exceeded, full SYMBA (e.g. AIBL AD vs CN AUROC of 0.90 vs 0.88 for the full model). The only tasks where its removal was clearly detrimental were ADNI 3-Class and Amyloid, where the full model retained a modest edge.
blocks.zh: 消除背景清除、半球对称和最小问题-折射限制(解剖有效性限制)一起产生较小和更选择性的效果。 关于ADNI AD vs CN和sMCI vs pMCI, 性能在统计学上与两个度量标准上的全部模型无法区分,在几个AIBL任务上(Sex BACC, AD vs CN AUROC, 和 3-Class AUROC), 减速变体的性能与全SYMBA相同,或名义上超过全SYMBA(如AIBL AD vs CN AUROC, 0.90 vs 0.88). 其移除明显有害的唯一任务是ADNI 3-Class和Amyloid,其中全型号保留了适度的边缘.

blocks.en: Table 6 : Ablation of anatomically constrained masking components within SYMBA. Each variant turned off one of the constraints of the final SYMBA configuration pipeline, enabling assessment of their marginal contribution to downstream performance on ADNI and AIBL. Results were reported as mean ± \pm standard deviation across 10 cross-validation folds. For each variant, the top row (white background) indicates Balanced Accuracy (BACC) and the bottom row (gray background) indicates AUROC (AUC). Bold indicates the best performance per task, and asterisk ( ∗ ) denotes statistically significant difference ( p < 0.05 p<0.05 ) compared to the baseline (SYMBA).
blocks.zh: 表6:SYMBA内解剖受限制的遮盖元件的缩合. 每个变体都消除了SYMBA最终配置管道的制约之一,从而能够评估其对ADNI和AIBL下游性能的边际贡献。 报告的结果为10个交叉验证折叠的平均值±\pm标准差。 对于每个变体,上行(白色背景)表示平衡精确度(BACC),下行(灰色背景)表示AUROC(AUC). 粗体表示每项任务的最佳业绩,星号(*)表示与基线(SYMBA)相比在统计学上有显著差异(p < 0.05 p < 0.05)。

blocks.en: 3.5.3 Reconstruction objective
blocks.zh: 3.5.3 重建目标

blocks.en: Table 7 : Effect of reconstruction objective on downstream performance within the SYMBA framework, comparing voxel-wise losses (MSE), structural similarity-based objectives (SSIM), hybrid formulations, and MS-SSIM supervision. Results are reported as mean ± \pm standard deviation across 10 cross-validation folds. For each variant, the top row (white background) indicates Balanced Accuracy (BACC) and the bottom row (gray background) indicates AUROC (AUC). Bold indicates the best performance per task, and asterisk ( ∗ ) denotes a statistically significant difference ( p < 0.05 p<0.05 ).
blocks.zh: 表7:重建目标在SYMBA框架内对下游性能的影响,比较吸氧亏损(MSE),基于结构的类似目标(SSIM),混合配方和MS-SSIM监督. 结果报告为10个交叉验证折叠的平均值±\pm标准差. 对于每个变体,上行(白色背景)表示平衡精确度(BACC),下行(灰色背景)表示AUROC(AUC). 粗体表示每项任务的最佳业绩,星号(*)表示统计上显著的差异(p < 0.05 p < 0.05)。

blocks.en: We investigated the influence of the reconstruction objective on the quality of the learned representations by comparing four commonly used losses within the proposed framework: voxel-wise Mean Squared Error (MSE), Structural Similarity (SSIM), a hybrid SSIM+L1 objective, and the MS-SSIM.
blocks.zh: 我们调查了重建目标对学到的表述质量的影响,比较了拟议框架内四个常用的损失:阴道平均方差错(MSE)、结构相似性(SSIM)、混合性(SSIM+L1)目标和MS-SSIM。

blocks.en: Table 7 showed that the reconstruction objective had a substantial impact on representation transferability. No single loss achieved the highest performance on every downstream task, indicating that each objective promoted different inductive biases during pretraining. MSE performed competitively on several ADNI tasks, achieving the highest performance AUC for MCI progression prediction and amyloid status.
blocks.zh: 表7显示,重建目标对代表移交能力产生了重大影响。 每项下游任务没有一项损失取得最高业绩,表明每个目标在训练前都造成不同的诱导性偏见。 MSE在几个ADNI任务上进行了竞争,实现了MCI进化预测和酰胺状态的最高性能AUC.

blocks.en: In contrast, objectives based on structural similarity exhibited better generalization across datasets. MS-SSIM objective achieved the highest Balanced accuracy across all ADNI tasks, including 3-Class disease staging and AD vs CN classification, while also securing top AUC scores for AD vs CN, 3-Class diagnosis and Sex prediction. On the independent AIBL cohort, MS-SSIM led in Balanced Accuracy for AD vs CN and 3-Class diagnosis, as well as Sex prediction. However, standard single-scale SSIM achieved the highest AUC for AIBL AD vs CN and 3-Class diagnosis.
blocks.zh: 与此相反,基于结构相似性的目标显示出各数据集之间更好的概括。 MS-SSIM目标在所有ADNI任务中实现了最高的平衡精确度,包括3级疾病中转和AD vs CN分类,同时也为AD vs CN,3级诊断和性别预测获得最高的AUC分数. 在独立的AIBL组中,MS-SSIM领导了AD对CN的平衡精确度和3级诊断以及性别预测. 然而,标准单级SSIM实现了AIBL AD对CN和3级诊断的最高AUC.

blocks.en: Interestingly, simply combining structural and voxel-wise supervision through the SSIM+L1 objective did not produce consistent improvements over either individual loss, with the exception of top Balanced Accuracy in AIBL Sex prediction. This indicated that the benefits of structural reconstruction were not obtained by adding a pixel-wise penalty, but rather by explicitly encouraging the model to preserve anatomical organization during reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 有趣的是,仅仅通过SSIM+L1目标将结构监督与阴性监督结合起来,并不能对两种损失都产生一致的改善,但AIBL性别预测中最高平衡准确性除外。 这表明,结构重建的好处不是通过增加像素式惩罚来获得的,而是通过明确鼓励在重建期间保留解剖组织的模式。

blocks.en: 3.6 Reconstruction analysis
blocks.zh: 3.6 重建分析

blocks.en:
To qualitatively assess the effect of the encoder architecture and parameters on the reconstruction process, Figure 4 shows two representative reconstructions obtained using the final SYMBA model under masking ratio of 75% and patch size 16. The example subjects were selected at random from the held-out test set without prior visual inspection to ensure unbiased sampling. While the quantitative evaluation throughout this work focused on the transferability of the learned representations rather than reconstruction quality itself, visual inspection provided additional insight into the information encoded in the latent space.
Specifically, by comparing the original volume, the 75% masked input, and the final reconstruction, we observed that the network successfully captured global contextual dependencies. Despite the heavily fragmented input, the model accurately recovered the overall anatomical structure and major boundary continuities.
blocks.zh:
为了从质量上评估编码器架构和参数对重建过程的影响,图4显示在75%的遮盖率和16的补丁尺寸下,使用最终SYMBA模型获得的两种具有代表性的重建. 示例主体是在未事先进行目视检查的情况下从搁置测试中随机挑选出来的,以确保无偏见的取样。 虽然在整个工作中进行的定量评价侧重于所学到的表述的可转移性,而不是重建质量本身,但视觉检查提供了对潜伏空间中编码的信息的进一步深入了解。
具体地说,通过比较原始的量,75%的遮掩输入,以及最后的重建,我们观察到这个网络成功地捕捉了全球背景的依赖性. 尽管投入十分分散,但模型准确地恢复了整体解剖结构和主要边界连续性.

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Representative reconstructions produced ResNet under the masking ratio (75%) and patch size 16 for the axial and coronal view. Columns correspond to the original image, masked input, reconstructed image, total absolute difference and masked difference respectively.
blocks.zh: 图4:代表重建按遮掩率(75%)生产ResNet,对轴和冠视图进行补丁尺寸16. 列分别对应原始图像,遮蔽输入,重建图像,总绝对差异和遮蔽差异.

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: This study investigated whether incorporating anatomical and morphological priors into self-supervised pretraining can improve the transferability of structural brain MRI representations for neurodegenerative disease analysis. The results suggest that the design of the pretraining objective plays an important role in determining the information retained in the learned representations. In particular, the performance of SYMBA across independent cohorts, heterogeneous downstream tasks, and limited-label settings supports the value of reconstruction objectives that encourage the modeling of spatial relationships and global brain morphology. Beyond the overall improvements in predictive performance, our findings provide insights into the relationship between self-supervised objectives, anatomical inductive biases, and downstream representation quality.
blocks.zh: 这项研究调查了将解剖学和形态学前科纳入自我监督的预训是否能够提高神经变性疾病分析中结构脑磁共振的可转移性。 结果表明,培训前目标的设计在确定所学到的陈述中保留的信息方面发挥着重要作用。 特别是,SYMBA在独立组群中的性能、不同下游任务和有限标签设置支持了重建目标的价值,鼓励建立空间关系和全球大脑形态模型。 除了预测性业绩的总体改善之外,我们的调查结果还深入了解了自我监督的目标、解剖性诱导性偏见和下游代表性质量之间的关系。

blocks.en: 4.1 Learning Morphological Representations for Neurodegenerative Disease Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.1 神经内分泌性疾病分析的临床表现

blocks.en: An important question in self-supervised neuroimaging is which anatomical properties a representation should preserve to support subsequent clinical analysis. Unlike tasks such as image registration or segmentation, which emphasize accurate spatial correspondence or local boundary delineation, neurodegenerative disease classification requires identifying structural variations that may be subtle, distributed, and spatially interdependent. This distinction has implications for the design of self-supervised objectives, since representations optimized for one anatomical task may not necessarily retain the information most relevant to another.
blocks.zh: 在自我监督的神经成像中的一个重要问题是,一个表现物应保存什么样的解剖特性,以支持随后的临床分析。 与强调准确空间通信或局部边界划定的图像注册或分化等任务不同,神经变性疾病分类要求识别可能微妙,分布,空间相互依存的结构变化. 这种区分对自我监督目标的设计有影响,因为为一项解剖任务优化的表述可能不一定保留与另一项任务最相关的信息。

blocks.en: The differences observed between SYMBA and the evaluated pretrained models are consistent with this interpretation. In contrast to objectives emphasizing instance discrimination, anatomical correspondence, or segmentation, SYMBA requires reconstructing missing tissue from the surrounding anatomical context. This encourages the encoder to retain information that supports the recovery of spatial relationships between brain structures, rather than optimizing exclusively for local features or similarity between augmented views. The progressive masking curriculum further introduces reconstruction problems at different spatial scales, potentially promoting representations that capture both localized anatomical variations and larger morphological patterns.
blocks.zh: 所观察到的SYMBA与被评价的预训模型之间的差异符合这一解释. 与强调实例歧视、解剖通信或分割的目标相反,SYMBA要求从周围解剖背景重建缺失的组织。 这鼓励编码器保留支持恢复大脑结构间空间关系的信息,而不是完全为了局部特征或增强观点之间的相似性而优化. 渐进式遮盖课程还引入了不同空间尺度的重建问题,有可能促进既反映局部解剖变异又反映较大形态形态的表示.

blocks.en: The differences across downstream tasks also provide insight into the information captured by these representations. While SYMBA performed well on established diagnostic categories, improvements were less pronounced for MCI progression and amyloid status prediction. This distinction is relevant because sMRI provides an indirect characterization of the underlying pathological processes. Clinical progression and molecular pathology cannot necessarily be inferred from macroscopic morphology with the same reliability as established disease-related anatomical differences. Consequently, the benefits of improved structural representation learning may be constrained by the information intrinsically available in the imaging modality.
blocks.zh: 下游任务之间的差异也使人们深入了解这些陈述所收集的信息。 虽然SYMBA在既定诊断类别上表现良好,但对MCI进化和酰胺状态预测的改进不太明显。 这种区分是相关的,因为SMRI提供了基础病理过程的间接特征. 临床进展和分子病理学不一定能以与既定的疾病相关解剖差异相同的可靠性从宏观形态学中推断出来。 因此,改善结构代表性学习的好处可能受成像模式内在可得信息的限制。

blocks.en: 4.2 Transferability and Label Efficiency
blocks.zh: 4.2 可转让性和标签效率

blocks.en: A central motivation for SSL in neuroimaging is the possibility of learning representations from heterogeneous unlabeled populations and transferring them to clinical cohorts where annotated data are limited. SYMBA was pretrained without access to either ADNI or AIBL, yet its representations supported multiple downstream classification tasks using frozen encoders and linear classifiers. This suggests that the pretrained latent space contains anatomical information that remains useful across populations and acquisition settings without requiring extensive task-specific adaptation.
blocks.zh: SSL在神经成像方面的中心动机是,有可能从各种无标签人群中学习表现,并将其转移到附加说明的数据有限的临床人群中。 SYMBA在无法访问ADNI或AIBL的情况下被预先训练,然而它的表示支持使用冻结编码器和线性分类器的多个下游分类任务. 这表明,预先经过培训的潜在空间包含解剖信息,这些信息在人群和获取环境中仍然有用,而不需要针对具体任务进行广泛的调整。

blocks.en: The use of frozen linear probing is particularly relevant to this interpretation. The evaluation reduces the extent to which differences in performance can be attributed to task-specific representation adaptation due to the restriction of downstream learning to a linear classifier. The resulting improvements therefore support the usefulness of the anatomical information encoded during pretraining. Nevertheless, this protocol evaluates linear accessibility of downstream information rather than the full potential of each architecture after fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 使用冷冻线性探测与这一解释特别相关。 由于下游学习仅限于线性分类者,评价降低了业绩差异可归因于任务特定表现适应的程度. 因此,由此产生的改进支持了在预训期间编码的解剖信息的效用。 尽管如此,该协议评价下游信息的线性可获取性,而不是在微调后评价每个架构的全部潜力.

blocks.en: The low-data experiments provide further evidence of this property. SYMBA’s advantage was most pronounced when very few labeled examples were available, suggesting that much of the information needed for downstream discrimination was already accessible in the pretrained feature space. From a practical perspective, this is particularly relevant to neuroimaging applications where obtaining reliable labels requires expensive biomarker measurements, specialist assessments, or prolonged clinical follow-up.
blocks.zh: 低数据实验为这种属性提供了进一步的证据. SYMBA的优势最明显,因为很少有标注的例子,这表明下游歧视所需的许多信息已经在经过预先训练的特征空间中可以获得。 从实际角度看,这与神经成像应用特别相关,因为获得可靠的标签需要昂贵的生物标志测量、专家评估或长期临床跟踪。

blocks.en: However, the different data efficiency curves reveal that the value of self-supervised pretraining is not uniform across tasks. For several ADNI classification problems, supervised models progressively approached the performance of SYMBA as more labeled examples became available. For MCI progression prediction, the supervised baseline eventually surpassed the frozen representations. One possible explanation is that pretraining captures broadly useful anatomical characteristics, whereas distinguishing stable from progressive MCI may benefit from learning more specific combinations of structural features that are not linearly accessible in the pretrained space.
blocks.zh: 然而,不同的数据效率曲线显示,自行监督的预训在任务之间并不统一. 对于一些ADNI分类问题,随着更多标注实例的出现,受监督的模型逐渐接近SYMBA的性能. 就MCI进展预测而言,受监督的基准最终超过了冻结的表述。 一种可能的解释是,预训捕捉到广泛有用的解剖特征,而区分稳定与进步的MCI可能得益于学习在预训空间中无法线性获取的结构特征的更具体的组合.

blocks.en: These observations suggest a complementary relationship between general-purpose pretraining and task-specific optimization. Frozen representations may be particularly attractive in severely data-constrained settings, whereas fine-tuning could become beneficial when larger annotated cohorts are available or when the prediction target requires more specialized information. Investigating this trade-off would help determine when the additional complexity of end-to-end adaptation is justified.
blocks.zh: 这些意见表明,一般目的预训与具体任务优化之间存在着互补关系。 在数据受到严重限制的情况下,冻结表述可能特别有吸引力,而如果有较多的附加说明的表述,或预测目标需要更专门的信息,则微调可能是有益的。 对这种权衡情况进行调查将有助于确定何时有理由进行端到端的调整。

blocks.en: 4.3 Anatomical Inductive Biases and Representation Quality
blocks.zh: 4.3 解剖诱导比子和代表质量

blocks.en: The ablation experiments offer additional insight into how architectural and methodological decisions influence representation learning. An important observation is that improvements do not arise uniformly from increasing architectural complexity or imposing additional anatomical constraints. Instead, the findings suggest a trade-off between preserving detailed spatial information and encouraging the encoder to learn compact representations of global brain morphology.
blocks.zh: 退约实验使人们进一步了解建筑和方法决定如何影响代表学习。 一个重要的观察是,改进不是由于建筑复杂性的增加或施加额外的解剖限制而统一的。 相反,这些研究结果表明,在保存详细的空间信息与鼓励编码器学习全球大脑形态的紧凑表述之间应作出权衡。

blocks.en: This trade-off is illustrated by the comparison between residual autoencoders and U-Net architectures. Although skip connections can facilitate reconstruction by transferring spatial information directly between encoder and decoder, they also provide pathways that bypass the latent bottleneck. In a representation-learning setting, this may reduce the need for the encoder to retain all the information required for reconstruction. The stronger performance of residual architectures on several disease-related tasks is consistent with this hypothesis, although the competitive performance of U-Net on other endpoints indicates that preserving fine-grained spatial detail can also be beneficial. Importantly, these findings do not establish that skip connections are universally detrimental, but rather suggest that reconstruction fidelity and downstream representation quality are not necessarily aligned.
blocks.zh: 剩余自动编码器与U-Net架构的比较就说明了这种权衡。 虽然跳过连接可以通过在编码器和解码器之间直接传输空间信息来方便重建,但它们也提供了绕过潜在瓶颈的路径. 在代表性学习环境中,这可能减少编码器保留重建所需的所有信息的必要性。 残留架构在几个与疾病有关的任务上表现得更好,这与这一假设是一致的,尽管U-Net在其他终点上的竞争性表现表明,保留精细的空间细节也可能是有益的. 重要的是,这些调查结果并未确定不连接是普遍有害的,而是表明重建忠心和下游代表的质量不一定一致。

blocks.en: The masking ablations reinforce the importance of the reconstruction problem presented to the encoder. The benefits associated with geometrically structured masking suggest that the spatial organization of missing information influences which anatomical dependencies the network learns. However, the less consistent contribution of additional masking constraints indicates that anatomical priors should not be assumed to be beneficial simply because they encode biological knowledge. Their usefulness depends on whether they encourage the model to preserve information relevant to the downstream task without unnecessarily restricting the variability encountered during pretraining.
blocks.zh: 蒙面擦伤加强了向编码器提出的重建问题的重要性。 与几何结构遮盖有关的益处表明,缺失信息的空间组织会影响网络的解剖依赖性。 然而,额外的遮盖限制所造成的不太一致的影响表明,不应仅仅因为解剖学前科将生物知识编码就认为它是有益的。 它们的有用性取决于它们是否鼓励该模式保存与下游任务有关的信息,同时又不无必要地限制在培训前遇到的变化。

blocks.en: A similar interpretation applies to the reconstruction objective. Whereas voxel-wise losses prioritize local intensity agreement, structural similarity objectives evaluate relationships involving local contrast and spatial organization. The overall performance of MS-SSIM is consistent with the hypothesis that multiscale structural reconstruction provides useful supervision for morphometric representation learning. Nevertheless, the competitive results obtained with MSE and single-scale SSIM on certain tasks indicate that different reconstruction criteria may favor different aspects of anatomical information. This raises the possibility that reconstruction objectives could be adapted to the characteristics of the intended downstream application rather than selected solely according to reconstruction accuracy.
blocks.zh: 类似的解释也适用于重建目标。 与Voxel-wiside的亏损优先处理局部强度协议,而结构相似性目标则评价涉及局部对比和空间组织的关系。 MS-SSIM的整体性能符合一个假设,即多规模的结构重建为进行尸检表现学习提供了有益的监督. 尽管如此,通过MSE和单规模的SSIM在某些任务上获得的竞争结果表明,不同的重建标准可能有利于解剖信息的不同方面. 这就有可能使重建目标适应预定下游应用的特点,而不是仅仅根据重建的准确性来选择。

blocks.en: Taken together, these findings suggest that effective self-supervised learning for structural neuroimaging requires balancing anatomical detail, spatial context, and latent compression. Rather than maximizing architectural capacity or reconstruction fidelity independently, the objective should be to encourage representations that retain informative morphological variation while remaining transferable across datasets and tasks.
blocks.zh: 综合这些发现,有效的自我监督的学习结构神经成像需要平衡解剖细节、空间背景和潜在的压缩。 目标不应是独立地最大限度地提高建筑能力或重建忠贞度,而应鼓励保留信息性形态变异的表述,同时保持可跨数据集和任务的可转让性。

blocks.en: 4.4 Limitations and Future Directions
blocks.zh: 4.4 限制和未来方向

blocks.en: Several limitations should be considered when interpreting these findings. First, although the evaluation included two independent cohorts excluded from SYMBA pretraining, the experiments do not explicitly isolate the effects of scanner characteristics, acquisition protocols, or population differences. Furthermore, some competing models were pretrained using data from the evaluation cohorts, complicating direct comparisons of their exposure to the target distributions. Additional experiments involving site-stratified evaluation or controlled acquisition shifts would be necessary to characterize robustness to these factors more precisely.
blocks.zh: 在解释这些调查结果时应考虑若干限制。 首先,虽然评价包括两个被排除在SYMBA预训之外的独立组别,但试验并未明确隔离扫描仪特性、购置协议或人口差异的影响。 此外,一些相互竞争的模型利用评价组的数据进行了预先培训,使直接比较它们与目标分布的接触情况变得复杂。 需要进行更多涉及现场评估或有控制的购置转移的实验,以便更准确地说明这些因素的可靠性。

blocks.en: Second, downstream evaluation relied primarily on frozen linear probing. While this provides a controlled means of assessing representation quality, it does not establish the maximum predictive performance achievable through adaptation. The results for MCI progression prediction particularly motivate investigating whether partial fine-tuning or parameter-efficient adaptation can complement the pretrained representations.
blocks.zh: 第二,下游评价主要依靠冷冻线性探测。 虽然这为评估代表性质量提供了一种可控手段,但并没有确定通过适应可达到的最大预测性能。 MCI进展预测的结果特别激励人们调查部分微调或参数效率调整是否能够补充预先培训的表述。

blocks.en: Third, the present framework is restricted to structural gray matter maps derived from T1-weighted MRI. Although these images provide valuable information about neurodegeneration, they cannot capture all aspects of disease pathology. Integrating complementary imaging modalities or clinical information could help address prediction problems in which morphological information alone is insufficient, particularly molecular biomarker estimation and early disease progression.
blocks.zh: 第三,目前的框架仅限于从T1加权磁共振中得出的结构灰色物质图. 虽然这些图像提供了有关神经衰变的宝贵信息,但它们无法捕捉疾病病理学的所有方面. 综合补充成像模式或临床信息可有助于解决仅靠形态信息不足的预测问题,特别是分子生物标志估计和早期疾病发展。

blocks.en: Finally, the analysis uses baseline structural images, without explicitly modeling within-subject changes over time. Although the proposed framework learns representations associated with subsequent clinical progression, it does not directly characterize longitudinal neurodegenerative trajectories. Extending anatomical self-supervision to repeated observations could provide a more direct means of learning how structural changes evolve, provided suitable longitudinal data are available.
blocks.zh: 最后,分析使用基线结构图像,但没有明确模拟主题内随时间推移的变化。 尽管拟议框架学习了与随后的临床进展相关的表述,但它并没有直接描述纵向神经退化轨迹。 如果有适当的纵向数据,将解剖自我监督扩大到反复观测,可以提供一种更直接的方法来了解结构变化如何演变。

blocks.en: Overall, this work supports anatomically informed reconstruction as a promising strategy for self-supervised structural MRI representation learning. More broadly, the findings emphasize that pretraining objectives should be designed around the anatomical information relevant to the intended downstream applications, while recognizing the trade-offs between general-purpose transferability and task-specific adaptation.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,这项工作支持在解剖学上知情的重建,作为自我监督的结构核磁共振代表性学习的有希望的战略。 更广泛地说,研究结果强调,培训前的目标应围绕与预期下游应用有关的解剖信息来设计,同时承认普通用途转移和针对具体任务的适应之间的权衡。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we presented SYMBA, a self-supervised pretraining framework systematically optimized for structural brain MRI analysis, demonstrating how neuroanatomical inductive biases yield highly generalizable representations tailored for neurodegenerative disease analysis. Through a rigorous evaluation pipeline, we demonstrate that anatomically-informed generative pretraining produces more transferable representations than existing SSL approaches for sMRI. Rather than adapting objectives originally developed for natural images, SYMBA incorporates neuroanatomical priors into the masking strategy, reconstruction objective, and training curriculum, encouraging the encoder to model structural brain organization across multiple spatial scales.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出了SYMBA,这是一个自我监督的预训框架,系统优化了结构脑磁共振分析,展示了神经解剖诱导偏差如何产生适合神经变性疾病分析的高度概括性表现. 通过严格的评价程序,我们表明,在解剖学上知情的基因预训所产生的可转移表述比现有SSL方法更能促进SMRI。 SYMBA没有调整最初为自然图像制定的目标,而是将神经解剖学前科纳入遮掩战略、重建目标和培训课程,鼓励编码器在多个空间尺度上模拟结构脑组织。

blocks.en: The deliberate methodological choice of using linear probing instead of fine-tuning allowed for a rigorous evaluation of the intrinsic quality of the learned latent space, removing the confounding variables and artifacts typically introduced by complex fine-tuning schedulers. Despite this conservative evaluation protocol, SYMBA demonstrated superior performance and out-of-domain generalizability across a diverse array of clinical tasks when evaluated on two independent and unseen external datasets, ADNI and AIBL.
blocks.zh: 采用线性测试而不是微调的审慎方法选择使得能够对所学到的潜在空间的内在质量进行严格的评价,消除了复杂微调调度器通常引入的困惑变量和文物。 尽管有这种保守的评价协议,但SYMBA在两个独立和看不见的外部数据集ADNI和AIBL上评价时,在各种各样的临床任务中表现出了优异的性能和域外通用性.

blocks.en:
The clinical applicability of this approach is more notable in our low-data regime evaluations. In extremely low-data settings, SYMBA achieved an AUROC close to 0.90 for Alzheimer’s disease classification using only six training samples (1% of the training data), drastically outperforming fully supervised baselines trained from scratch. This result indicates that much of the disease-discriminative information is already encoded during pretraining, substantially reducing the dependence on large annotated cohorts.
Our findings also suggest that for structural MRI the explicit adaptation of the SSL objective to the spatial organization of brain morphology is critical.
Future work will investigate parameter-efficient adaptation strategies, multimodal downstream tasks, and transfer to rarer neurological disorders where labeled data remain extremely limited.
blocks.zh:
在我们的低数据制度评价中,这种方法在临床上的适用性更为显著。 在极低的数据环境下,SYMBA只使用6个培训样本(培训数据的1%)实现了近0.90的阿尔茨海默氏病分类AUROC,从零开始就大大超过完全监督的基线。 这一结果表明,许多疾病歧视信息在预训期间已经编码,大大减少了对大量附加说明的人群的依赖。
我们的调查结果还表明,对于结构核磁共振来说,明确调整SSL目标以适应大脑形态的空间组织至关重要。
今后的工作将调查参数效率高的适应战略、多模式下游任务,以及转移到贴有标签的数据仍然极为有限的稀有神经病。
